reader_summary.overview: This week's Summer Series is an asset class twofer covering hedge funds and private equity. The first is a hedge fund panel comprised of Dan Fagan from GIC of Singapore, Craig Bergstrom from Corbin Capital Partners. The second is with Mario Giannini, Executive Co-Chairman of Hamilton Lane.

key_points.text: The first is a hedge fund panel comprised of Dan Fagan from GIC of Singapore, Craig Bergstrom from Corbin Capital Partners.
Both offer deep dives into what it takes successfully invest as an asset class specialist.
Please enjoy my panel with Dan, Craig, and Adam from 2023 and with Mario Giannini from 2022.
